wing_name: Hacking Resource, Then a Program Download (Behaviour)
description: One person visits a site UBA classes as a hacking resource (exploit and tool repositories, cracking forums) and, within two hours, downloads a program. UBA rules: browser_visit_hacking_resource then browser_download_executable. Security staff do this as part of their work.
proves: A person downloaded a program soon after visiting a hacking resource
author: Crow-Eye Team
